title: Murder Suspect Blows His Cover by Shoplifting at Walmart: Cops
description:
A man was arrested at a Walmart in Albuquerque, New Mexico when an alleged shoplifting scandal uncovered he was actually wanted in connection to a deadly shooting. Police took Jamil Lewis, 26, into custody after he was caught by store employees allegedly concealing items. Loss prevention alerted police that Jamil may be carrying a gun, and when police confronted the 26-year-old a chaotic scene unfolded. Investigators later discovered the suspected shoplifter was wanted in connection to a shooting that left a 44-year-old man dead and another injured just a month before. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
